title: Timing Is Everything: Labor Market Winners and Losers during a Boom-Bust Cycle
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: The Creation and Extent of America's First Environmental Agencies
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Why do administrative agencies form and expand or shrink? We study America’s oldest environmental bureaucracies—US state wildlife agencies—from their inception during America’s age of wildlife extermination to their manifestation as modern administrative agencies to gain insight. We develop a framework in which demand for agencies depends positively on the costs private landowners would incur to coordinate and self-regulate against overharvest and on the state’s capacity to administer regulations. We test implications by examining the timing of state agency creation from 1870 through 1920, changes in the size of agency budgets since the mid-twentieth century, and the proportion of modern budgets spent on nongame species for which private control is least profitable. Estimates show that high levels of state capacity and private contracting costs, caused by small landholdings and weak rights against trespass, are associated with earlier and larger agencies with less focus on nongame.
abstract_zh: 行政机构为何设立，又为何扩张或收缩？我们研究美国最古老的环境官僚机构——各州的野生动物管理机构——从其在野生动物大规模灭绝时代的成立，到发展为现代行政机构的全过程，以获得相关洞见。我们构建了一个框架，其中对机构的需求，一方面取决于私人土地所有者为协调和自我约束以防止过度捕猎所需承担的成本，另一方面取决于州政府执行监管的能力。我们通过考察1870至1920年间各州机构设立的时间、自20世纪中叶以来机构预算规模的变化，以及现代预算中用于非狩猎物种（nongame species，即私人控制最不具利润的物种）的比例，来检验这些推论。估计结果表明，较高的国家能力水平，以及由小规模土地持有和薄弱的反非法侵入权利所导致的较高私人契约成本，与机构成立更早、规模更大，且较少关注非狩猎物种相关。

title: Causes and Consequences of Policy Uncertainty: Evidence from McGirt vs. Oklahoma
Option Value of Apex Predators: Evidence from a River Discontinuity
Science versus Subjectivity in Environmental Research
abstract: Objective science aims to uncover truths about environmental conditions, including those related to emission trends, biodiversity loss, climate change, and their economic costs. When and why do scientists use subjective language to describe these conditions with bias, emotion, or advocacy? To shed light, we study determinants and trends in subjective language within the abstracts, introductions, and conclusions of over 170,000 peer-reviewed articles published during 1990-2023 in top economics and science journals. Using machine learning to label and score text by subjectivity, we find that subjective language is more prevalent in articles focused on environmental topics relative to non-environmental topics: by 12% in economics and by 42% in science. After accounting for factors such as article age, author experience, number of authors, and journal quality, higher subjectivity scores associate positively with future academic citations in both science and economics, especially if the article is focused on an environmental topic. These findings, which imply subjective language has been rewarded in the academy, are consistent with informal theory suggesting subjective language will be used more frequently by scientists when expected rewards are high and risks are low.
abstract_zh: 客观科学旨在揭示环境状况的真相，包括与排放趋势、生物多样性丧失、气候变化及其经济成本相关的真相。科学家何时以及为何使用带有偏见、情绪或倡导色彩的主观语言来描述这些状况？为探究此问题，我们研究了1990至2023年间发表于顶尖经济学和科学期刊的逾17万篇同行评审文章的摘要、引言和结论中主观语言的决定因素与趋势。我们使用机器学习对文本的主观性进行标注和打分，发现与非环境主题相比，关注环境主题的文章中主观语言更为普遍：在经济学中高出12%，在科学领域中高出42%。在控制了文章年龄、作者经验、作者人数和期刊质量等因素之后，主观性得分越高，与未来学术引用量的正相关性在经济学和科学中均成立，且当文章聚焦于环境主题时这种关联尤为明显。这些发现表明，主观语言在学术界一直受到奖励，这与一种非正式理论相一致，即当预期回报高而风险低时，科学家会更频繁地使用主观语言。

title: Trading Green: Do Tax Credit Markets Improve Land Conservation?
abstract:
Governments traditionally use top-down regulations to mandate conservation on private land but voluntary, incentive-based Payments for Environmental Services (PES) are an emerging alternative. Critics worry that PES programs subsidize wealthy landowners who would have conserved absent compensation and fail to target lands with high conservation value.
We ask how conservation incentives can be made more effective in the context of the United States' dominant PES system - conservation easements, covering 38 million acres and funded primarily by tax breaks. We hypothesize that markets for transferable tax credits will expand participation among low-income landowners while also improving conservation outcomes. Using a calculator of federal and state tax codes from 1990-2025 and policy changes in five states allowing transferability, we find that before markets, high-income donors faced a much lower after-tax cost of conservation than low and medium-income donors. Markets shrunk this gap and the donation responses across income levels leading to a greater proportion of easements over farmland under conversion pressure relative to non-working lands hosting second-homes. Markets also increased measures of ecological value and agricultural soil quality across easements. These results demonstrate how decentralized trade in tax credits can improve conservation targeting without subsidy expansion or new ecological mandates.
abstract_zh:
政府传统上通过自上而下的监管，强制要求私人土地进行保护；而自愿性的、基于激励的环境服务支付（PES）则是一种新兴的替代方式。批评者担心，PES项目会补贴那些即使没有补偿也会进行保护的富裕土地所有者，并且无法将资金瞄准具有高保护价值的土地。
我们探讨在美国占主导地位的PES体系——保护地役权（覆盖3800万英亩土地，主要由税收减免提供资金）背景下，如何提高保护激励的有效性。我们假设，可转让税收抵免市场将扩大低收入土地所有者的参与，同时改善保护成效。利用1990至2025年联邦和州税法计算器，以及五个州允许税收抵免转让的政策变化，我们发现，在市场建立之前，高收入捐赠者的保护税后成本远低于中低收入捐赠者。市场的建立缩小了这一差距，并使各收入水平的捐赠反应趋于一致，从而使面临转为非农用途压力的农田上的地役权比例，相对于用于第二套住房的非耕作用地有所提高。市场还提高了各地役权的生态价值及农业土壤质量指标。这些结果表明，税收抵免的分散式交易可以在不扩大补贴规模、也不增加新的生态强制性规定的情况下，改善保护的瞄准效果。

title: Wolf Recovery and Livestock Loss in the American West
Culture, Sovereignty, and the Rule of Law: Lessons from Indian Country
Economic Potential of Wind and Solar in American Indian Communities
Effects of Per-Capita Payments on Governance: Evidence from Tribal Casinos
Farm Size, Spatial Externalities, and Wind Energy Development
abstract: The global push for renewable energy must overcome the local challenge of convincing neighboring landowners to lease their properties for wind power. Is this challenge more or less pronounced in rural landscapes with small landholdings? Our theoretical model combines ideas from literatures on the commons, anticommons, and spatial externalities to explain conditions when small landholdings could promote or inhibit voluntary leasing. Empirically, we estimate the effects of landholding size and landscape fragmentation on wind farm uptake across rural areas of the United States over the past 20 years. Evidence from three spatial levels of analysis (counties, square‐mile sections, and individual parcels) indicates that areas with more landowners have less installed wind capacity after controlling for windiness, access to transmission lines, and other relevant factors that vary across and within counties. The findings imply that fragmented ownership, which is an overlooked factor in studies of the feasibility of decarbonization, will pose an impediment to future wind expansion on private land as remaining areas without wind development become disproportionately fragmented.
abstract_zh: 全球推动可再生能源发展，必须克服一个地方性难题：说服相邻土地所有者将其地产租赁用于风力发电。在小农场为主的农村地区，这一难题是更突出还是更不突出？我们的理论模型结合了公共资源、反公地以及空间外部性等文献中的观点，以解释在何种条件下，小规模土地所有制可能促进或抑制自愿租赁。在实证方面，我们估计了过去20年间，土地所有规模和景观破碎化对美国农村地区风电场建设的影响。基于县、平方英里地块及单个宗地三个空间层次的分析表明，在控制了风力资源、输电线路可达性以及其他在县域间和县域内部有所差异的相关因素之后，土地所有者数量较多的地区，其已安装风电容量反而较少。研究结果表明，破碎化的土地所有权是可再生能源脱碳可行性研究中一个常被忽视的因素，它将成为私人土地上未来风电扩张的障碍，因为尚未开发风电的地区将变得日益破碎化。

title: The Effects of Mining on Poverty in Developing Countries
Are Resource Booms a Blessing or a Curse? Evidence from People (not Places)
Federal Funding and State Wildlife Conservation
abstract: Federal aid programs subsidize local governments in sectors ranging from health care to transportation, but there is little empirical study of their effects on local provision. We examine the effects of the 1937 Pittman-Robertson Wildlife Restoration Act, which directed federal excise taxes on guns and hunting equipment to wildlife agencies on the condition that receiving states stop diverting license funds to purposes unrelated to wildlife conservation. Using panel data from 1925 to 1937, we find that states with larger administrative sectors were more apt to divert wildlife revenues, and these diversions correlate with fewer licenses sold, suggesting adverse effects of diversions on wildlife conservation. Data from 1938–2018 suggest the Pittman-Robertson Act increased license sales and revenue, leading to positive effects on long-run conservation.
abstract_zh: 联邦援助计划为从医疗保健到交通等各领域的地方政府提供补贴，但关于其对地方公共品供给影响的实证研究很少。我们考察了1937年《皮特曼—罗伯逊野生动物恢复法》（Pittman-Robertson Wildlife Restoration Act）的效果。该法将枪支和狩猎装备的联邦消费税收入分配给野生动物管理机构，条件是接受资金的州停止将许可证收入挪用于与野生动物保护无关的用途。利用1925至1937年的面板数据，我们发现行政部门规模较大的州更倾向于挪用野生动物收入，而这些挪用与许可证销售量减少相关，表明挪用对野生动物保护具有不利影响。1938至2018年的数据表明，《皮特曼—罗伯逊法》增加了许可证销售量和收入，从而对长期保护产生了积极影响。

title: Allow Non-Use Rights to Conserve Natural Resources
Fragmented Ownership and Natural Resource Use: Evidence from the Bakken
abstract: Does land fragmentation impair spatially expansive natural resource use? We conduct empirical tests using ownership variation on the Bakken, one of the world's most valuable shale oil reserves. Long before shale was discovered, US policies created a mosaic of private, jointly owned and tribal government parcels on the Fort Berthold Indian Reservation. We find that all three forms of fragmentation reduced production during the 2010–15 oil boom, especially joint ownership and the interspersion of small parcels of government and private land. We estimate implied gains from consolidation and discuss implications for the use (or conservation) of other spatially expansive resources.
abstract_zh: 土地破碎化是否会妨碍需要大面积铺展的自然资源开发？我们利用巴肯（Bakken）油田的产权差异进行了实证检验。巴肯是世界上最具价值的页岩油储量之一。早在页岩油被发现之前，美国政策就在福特伯尔德印第安保留地上形成了由私人、共同所有及部落政府持有的镶嵌式地块格局。我们发现，在2010至2015年的石油繁荣期间，这三种形式的破碎化都降低了产量，其中尤以共同所有权以及政府与私人小块土地相互穿插的情形为甚。我们估计了土地整合可带来的潜在收益，并探讨了其对其他需要大面积铺展的资源的开发（或保护）的启示。

title: Self-Governance and Development on American Indian Reservations
Wolves Make Roadways Safer, Generating Large Economic Returns to Predator Conservation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_zh: 衡量捕食者所带来的经济效益十分困难，因为其影响往往是间接的，并通过复杂的生态变化而发生。因此，关于扩大捕食者种群的争论，常常将显著的成本与较为推测性的效益估计相对立，而后者可能被视为不可靠或出于意识形态动机而遭到摒弃。我们量化了狼（Canis lupus）通过减少鹿与车辆碰撞，为人类生命和财产带来的间接效益。此外，我们将该效应分解为两个组成部分：猎物行为的变化与猎物数量的变化。当有效的政策取决于猎人能否复制捕食者的作用时，这一分解尤为重要。就狼而言，我们的结论是：人类猎鹿者无法做到这一点。

title: Land Quality, Land Rights, and Indigenous Poverty
An Economic Approach to Perennial Farm-Scale Water Demand Management for Water Rights Markets
Distributional Effects of Conservation Easements
Private Land Conservation and Public Policy
abstract: We highlight the extraordinary growth in private conservation via land trusts and conservation easements and describe the problems arising from the interplay of public finance and private decisions. We offer a framework for understanding the popularity of easements and land trusts and for evaluating policy reforms aimed at improving their performance. The framework, grounded in institutional and organizational economics in the tradition of Ronald Coase, Oliver Williamson, and Yoram Barzel, focuses on the measurement and monitoring costs faced by public and private stakeholders under current and prospective policy arrangements. We illustrate how the framework can be applied to contemporary debates about the appropriate tax treatment of donated easements, requirements that they be held in perpetuity, and the extent to which government should regulate private land trusts.
abstract_zh: 我们强调了通过土地信托和保护地役权进行的私人保护所取得的显著增长，并阐述了公共财政与私人决策相互作用所引发的问题。我们提供了一个框架，用以理解地役权和土地信托的普及原因，并评估旨在改善其绩效的政策改革。该框架以罗纳德·科斯、奥利弗·威廉姆森和约拉姆·巴泽尔所开创的制度与组织经济学为基础，重点关注在现行及潜在政策安排下，公共与私人利益相关方所面临的计量和监督成本。我们说明了该框架如何应用于当代的若干争论，包括捐赠地役权的适当税收处理、地役权须永久持有的要求，以及政府应在多大程度上监管私人土地信托。

title: Private Organizations, Public Data: Land Trust Choices about Mapping Conservation Easements
Questions of Property Rights
venue: Research Agenda for New Institutional Economics

title: Tax Incentives and the Price of Conservation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We study the role of tax incentives in promoting a fast-growing and novel type of conservation: voluntary, permanent restrictions on private land use through conservation easements. In the United States, easements represent the largest charitable gift on a per-donation basis, but skeptics wonder if their tax preference merely subsidizes wealthy landowners rather than inducing conservation. We incorporate federal and state income tax codes into a calculator to quantify the after-tax donation price and demonstrate its sensitivity to landowner income and state and federal policies. Using a 1987–2012 panel, we measure the response of state-level easements to the price. Our large elasticity estimates, spanning −2.4 to −6.1, indicate that tax incentives induce conservation and do not merely subsidize it. We find no evidence that generous tax benefits have caused less strategic patterns of land conservation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究税收激励在促进一种快速增长的新型保护方式中的作用：通过保护地役权，对私人土地使用实施自愿性的永久限制。在美国，地役权按每笔捐赠计算，是最大的慈善捐赠类型，但也有批评者怀疑，其税收优惠是在补贴富裕土地所有者，而非真正激励保护行为。我们将联邦和州所得税法纳入一个计算器，以量化税后捐赠价格，并展示其对土地所有者收入以及州和联邦政策的敏感性。利用1987至2012年的面板数据，我们衡量了州一级地役权对该价格的反应。我们估计的弹性较大，介于−2.4至−6.1之间，表明税收激励确实能够促进保护，而非仅仅补贴保护。我们没有发现证据表明，慷慨的税收优惠导致了较少战略性的土地保护格局。

title: Lessons in Fiscal Federalism from American Indian Nations
venue: The Law and Economics of Federalism

title: Resource Cursed or Policy Cursed? US Regulation of Conflict Minerals and Violence in the Congo
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: There is widespread belief that civil conflict in poorly governed countries is triggered by surging international demand for their natural resources. We study the consequences of US legislation grounded in this belief, the “conflict minerals” section of the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act. Targeting the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, it cuts funding to warlords by discouraging manufacturers from sourcing tin, tungsten, and tantalum from the region. Building from Mancur Olson’s stationary bandit metaphor, we describe some channels through which the legislation could backfire, inciting violence. Using georeferenced data, we find the legislation increased looting of civilians and shifted militia battles toward unregulated gold-mining territories. These findings are a cautionary tale about the possible unintended consequences of imposing boycotts, trade embargoes, and resource certification schemes on war-torn regions.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，治理不善国家的内乱是由国际市场对其自然资源的激增需求引发的。我们研究了基于这一信念而制定的美国立法的后果，即2010年《多德－弗兰克法案》中的“冲突矿产”条款。该条款针对刚果民主共和国东部地区，通过阻止制造商从该地区采购锡、钨和钽，切断军阀的资金来源。借鉴曼瑟尔·奥尔森的固定流寇（stationary bandit）比喻，我们描述了该立法可能适得其反、加剧暴力的若干渠道。利用地理参照数据，我们发现，该立法加剧了对平民的抢掠，并使民兵冲突转向未受监管的黄金开采地区。这些发现警示人们，对战乱地区实施抵制、贸易禁运和资源认证等措施，可能会产生意想不到的后果。

title: Unintended Consequences of Sanctions for Human Rights: Conflict Minerals and Infant Mortality
abstract: Are victims of human rights abuses better off with or without economic sanctions targeted at their perpetrators? We study this question in the context of a US human rights policy, the conflict-minerals section of the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act. By discouraging companies from sourcing tin, tungsten, and tantalum from the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the policy has acted as a de facto boycott on mineral purchases that may finance warlords and armed militias. We estimate the policy’s impact on the mortality of children born before 2013 and find that it increased the probability of infant deaths in villages near the policy-targeted mines by at least 143 percent. We find suggestive evidence that the legislation-induced boycott did so by reducing mothers’ consumption of infant health care goods and services.
abstract_zh: 对于人权侵害的受害者而言，针对施害者的经济制裁究竟是让他们的处境变好还是变坏？我们在美国一项人权政策的背景下研究这一问题，即2010年《多德－弗兰克法案》中的冲突矿产条款。该政策阻止企业从刚果民主共和国东部采购锡、钨和钽，实际上对可能资助军阀和武装民兵的矿产采购形成了事实上的抵制。我们估计了该政策对2013年前出生儿童死亡率的影响，发现其使政策所针对矿区附近村庄的婴儿死亡概率至少提高了143%。我们发现有一定证据表明，立法引发的抵制是通过减少母亲对婴儿保健用品和服务的消费而造成上述结果的。

title: Reforming Fisheries: Lessons from a Self-Selected Cooperative
The Political Economy of Fishery Reform
abstract: Despite compelling evidence that property rights–based management can improve the economic and ecological performance of fisheries, reform proposals are often met with political opposition. Moreover, the opposition sometimes comes from incumbent fishermen and fishing communities that would ostensibly gain the most from rent-enhancing reforms. We flesh out this puzzle by describing the political economy of past and present institutional changes in North America such as bans on fish traps, limited-entry regulations, and individual transferable quotas (ITQs). Our review identifies patterns of distributional concerns surrounding property rights; many of the same groups that opposed limits on entry and fish traps also oppose ITQs. We provide examples of how political opposition to ITQs is mollified by modifications in program design, although these design compromises may have efficiency costs. We conclude by pointing to the need for more research on equity-efficiency trade-offs and for greater attention to fishermen heterogeneity in economic analysis.
abstract_zh: 尽管有充分证据表明，基于产权的管理能够改善渔业的经济和生态绩效，但改革提议往往遭到政治反对。更有甚者，反对有时来自那些本应从增租改革中获益最多的现有渔民及渔业社区。我们通过描述北美过去和现在的制度变革（如禁用渔栅、限制准入以及个别可转让配额（ITQ））的政治经济学，阐明了这一谜题。我们的回顾揭示了围绕产权的分配性关切模式：许多反对限制准入和渔栅的群体，同样反对个别可转让配额。我们还举例说明，对个别可转让配额的政治反对如何通过项目设计的调整而得以缓和，尽管这些设计上的妥协可能带来效率成本。最后，我们指出，需要对公平与效率之间的权衡开展更多研究，并在经济分析中更加关注渔民的异质性。

title: Transaction Costs and Environmental Markets: The Role of Entrepreneurs
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: At the core of environmental economics is the potential for a divergence between private and social costs (based on the work of A. C. Pigou) and the potential for private contracts to shrink this divergence (based on the work of Ronald Coase). A close examination of Pigou and Coase reveals that the two are not so far apart, with Pigou emphasizing “technical difficulties” and Coase emphasizing transaction costs as the reason that private actors do not account for all costs and benefits. Building from this emphasis on transaction costs, we identify environmental entrepreneurship as an important but underappreciated force for improving resource allocation. Entrepreneurs guide the evolution of property rights, which in turn can lower the transaction costs of using markets to solve environmental problems. We define three types of entrepreneurs—those who contract over existing property rights in innovative ways, those who create new environmental property rights, and those who elicit private payments for public goods—and provide examples of how these entrepreneurs have improved resource allocation. These examples offer lessons about how government can encourage or discourage entrepreneurship.
abstract_zh: 环境经济学的核心在于，私人成本与社会成本之间可能存在背离（基于A. C. 庇古的研究），以及私人契约可能缩小这一背离（基于罗纳德·科斯的研究）。仔细考察庇古和科斯的观点后可以发现，两者并非相去甚远：庇古强调的是“技术困难”，而科斯强调的是交易成本，两者都是私人主体未能计入全部成本和收益的原因。基于科斯对交易成本的强调，我们认为环境企业家精神是一种重要但未被充分认识的、促进资源配置改善的力量。企业家引导产权的演进，而产权的演进又可以降低利用市场解决环境问题的交易成本。我们将企业家划分为三类：以创新方式就既有产权进行契约安排的企业家、创造新的环境产权的企业家，以及为公共物品获取私人支付的企业家；并举例说明这些企业家如何改善了资源配置。这些例子为政府如何鼓励或抑制企业家精神提供了启示。

title: Crowding Out Open Space: The Effects of Federal Land Programs on Private Land Trust Conservation
abstract: We examine the effects of U.S. federal land programs on private conservation using county-level panel regressions. Private conservation data measure acres held by The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and by participants in Land Trust Alliance (LTA) censuses. Government data measure federal landholdings (e.g., national parks and forests) and enrollment in the Conservation and Wetland Reserves (CRP and WRP). We find a small crowding-out effect from the CRP on LTA trusts. With TNC, we find crowding in from the CRP and crowding out from federal landholdings. Our theory gives insights as to why these and other effects (e.g., population and income) differ between TNC and the LTA trusts. (JEL H41, Q38)
abstract_zh: 我们利用县级面板回归，考察了美国联邦土地计划对私人保护的影响。私人保护数据衡量的是大自然保护协会（TNC）以及土地信托联盟（LTA）普查参与者所持有的土地面积。政府数据衡量的是联邦土地持有量（如国家公园和国家森林），以及保护性储备计划（CRP）和湿地保护计划（WRP）的参与情况。我们发现，CRP对LTA信托存在较小的挤出效应。对于TNC，我们发现CRP产生挤入效应，而联邦土地持有则产生挤出效应。我们的理论解释了为何这些效应（以及人口和收入等其他效应）在TNC与LTA信托之间存在差异。（JEL H41, Q38）

title: Encumbering Harvest Rights to Protect Marine Environments: A Model of Marine Conservation Easements
venue: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: We adapt the concept of a conservation easement to a marine environment and explore its use to achieve conservation goals. Although marine environments generally are not owned, those who use them for commercial fishing often are regulated. These regulations grant harvesters rights to use marine environments in specified ways, and the possibility of encumbering these rights to achieve conservation goals creates a potential role for marine easements. We examine this potential under alternative fishery management regimes and find, generally, that marine easements tend to be most effective when harvest rights are delineated most fully. Our analysis suggests ways that marine easements can have flexibility and transactions cost advantages over other approaches to achieve marine conservation goals. We also propose ways in which the design of laws allowing marine easements should follow, or depart from, the design of laws authorising conservation easements on land.
abstract_zh: 我们将保护地役权的概念引入海洋环境，并探讨其在实现保护目标方面的运用。尽管海洋环境通常不被私人拥有，但从事商业捕捞的人往往受到监管。这些监管赋予捕捞者以特定方式利用海洋环境的权利，而对这些权利施加负担以实现保护目标的可能性，为海洋地役权创造了潜在作用。我们在不同的渔业管理制度下考察了这一潜力，发现总体而言，当捕捞权划定得最为充分时，海洋地役权往往最为有效。我们的分析表明，相较于实现海洋保护目标的其他途径，海洋地役权在灵活性和交易成本方面可能具有优势。我们还提出了允许设立海洋地役权的法律设计应如何借鉴，或在何种程度上偏离规范陆地保护地役权的法律设计。
